scenario: Northgate Auto installed a new waste-oil underground tank with a maximum capacity of 95 gallons. The owner asks whether registration and leak-detection rules apply.
policy: An underground storage tank (UST) owner must register the tank and comply with the leak-detection requirements, except that tanks with a capacity of 110 gallons or less are excluded from the UST program and need not be registered.
question: Must Northgate Auto register the 95-gallon tank and comply with leak-detection requirements?
